whyDesignRequired: Yumu/Kanon bridge protocol returns rendered text/images only (LocalBotReply); no domain object is available to hand off
the observer requires domain facts, and the only Wuxin-side source is a fresh osu API fetch
a local handoff without a domain object would force parsing rendered output (forbidden) or dropping the observation (forbidden)
fetching authoritative data first and rendering internally would change the visible artifact (original target panel semantics)
therefore eliminating the refetch requires a protocol extension (domainResult/observationPayload across the bridge), a target-side change, or a visible-rendering architecture decision

designOptions.name: extend LocalBotReply/bridge contract with optional domainResult or observationPayload when a target can provide it
designOptions.impact: satisfies the ideal once/for yumu and kanon, but targets do not currently expose domain data through the OneBot WS path; effectively a target-side protocol change

designOptions.name: single Wuxin-side authoritative fetch + internal renderer for image-only recent
designOptions.impact: one semantic fetch feeds both renderer and observer; changes visible panel source (loses original target rendering)
designOptions.recommendation: requires explicit product decision on visible semantics

designOptions.name: defer observation detail: record username+capability placeholder now, let follow-up LLM call query_osu recent
designOptions.impact: removes post-success refetch; follow-up turn pays one INDEPENDENT_FOLLOWUP_FETCH; context freshness improves but immediate context detail is lost
designOptions.recommendation: smallest change if freshness tradeoff is accepted; still a semantic decision, not implemented

designOptions.name: request-scoped QuickExecutionResult { reply, domainResult?, observationPayload? }
designOptions.impact: correct shape for future handoff; only helps paths that already own a domain object (executor internal), which do not refetch today
designOptions.recommendation: adopt as the contract when a fix is authorized
